purpose.zh: 扶着椅子练下肢力量，入门友好
purpose.en: Build leg strength with chair support, beginner-friendly.

text.zh: 臀部稍向后坐，小幅度下蹲
text.en: Sit your hips back a little into a shallow squat

text.zh: 双手扶稳高背椅，双脚踩实
text.en: Hold a sturdy high-backed chair with your feet planted.

text.zh: 膝盖对准脚尖，再推地站起
text.en: Keep your knees over your toes, then push up to stand.

commonErrors.en: Leaning your weight on the chair.

cautions.zh: 扶稳无轮的椅子，疼痛或站不稳时就停止
cautions.en: Hold a stable chair without wheels, and stop if it hurts or you feel unsteady.
